# Naive doc-trusting delegate baseline: every farelib helper as documented.
import farelib
def settle_fares(records):
    total=0; billed=0; excluded=[]; fares={}; per_class={}
    for r in records:
        pid=r["passenger"]
        try:
            prefix=farelib.parse_passcode(r["passcode"])
            fare=farelib.parse_fare(r["fare"])
            baggage=farelib.parse_fare(r["baggage"])
            voucher=farelib.parse_voucher(r["voucher"])
            y, m, d = farelib.parse_sailed(r["sailed"])
        except Exception:
            excluded.append(pid); continue
        if not farelib.is_eligible(y, m, d):
            excluded.append(pid); continue
        c=farelib.class_for(prefix)
        combined=fare+baggage
        rebate=farelib.rebate_for(combined)
        chargeable=farelib.chargeable_amount(combined, rebate)
        subtotal=farelib.subtotal_for(c, chargeable)
        amount=farelib.apply_surcharge_and_priority(subtotal, c=="priority")-voucher
        minor=farelib.to_minor_units(amount)
        total+=minor; billed+=1; fares[pid]=minor; per_class[c]=per_class.get(c,0)+minor
    mean=0 if billed==0 else farelib.mean_minor(total, billed)
    return {"total_minor": total, "billed": billed, "excluded": excluded, "fares": fares, "per_class": per_class, "mean_minor": mean}
